about.intro: The open-source home for your TV Time. Track shows and movies, import your full TV Time history, and export everything back out at any time — your library belongs to you.
about.privacyBody: Everything stays on your device. Your library, watch history, votes, comments and photos live in a local database and never leave your phone. The app makes network requests only to TheTVDB and TMDB, to fetch artwork and show information — no accounts, no analytics, no tracking.
about.dataSourcesBody: Show and movie metadata and artwork — episode lists, names, air dates, artwork, genres and cast — are supplied by TheTVDB, the same database TV Time was built on. Please consider adding missing information there, or subscribing to support them.
about.tmdbNote: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB. TMDB supplies streaming availability, similar shows and star ratings.

tvdbKey.title: TheTVDB key
tvdbKey.warningText: The app’s shared TheTVDB key isn’t working right now. Adding your own free key restores full show & movie matching. You can also ignore this — OpenTV keeps working using TMDB.
tvdbKey.body: OpenTV matches shows and movies against TMDB first, and uses TheTVDB to fill what TMDB can’t. It ships with a shared TheTVDB key, so you don’t need one. If that shared key ever stops working, add your own here for the most reliable matching.
tvdbKey.bodyDim: It’s free: create an account at thetvdb.com, open Dashboard → API, and copy your v4 API key. Stored only on this device.
tvdbKey.placeholder: Paste your TheTVDB v4 API key
tvdbKey.getFreeKey: Get a free key at thetvdb.com →
tvdbKey.statusSharedFailed: Shared key: not working — falling back to TMDB
tvdbKey.keySavedBody: OpenTV will use your key for TheTVDB matching. It takes effect on the next lookup.
tvdbKey.keyClearedBody: Removed — OpenTV falls back to its shared key, then to TMDB.

notOnTvdb.title: Not on TheTVDB yet
notOnTvdb.body:
OpenTV tracks episodes using TheTVDB, and "{{name}}" hasn't been added there yet — which is common for shows that have only just aired.

It usually appears within a few weeks, and will add normally once it does.
